```renyi
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal

  let sub be subtotal(invoice)
  let discount_amount be sub * invoice.discount_percent / 100
  let after_discount be sub - discount_amount
  return after_discount.rounded()
end
```
